mapper.insert: insert into coupon_source_grant (source_type, source_id, member_id, coupon_id, created_at) values (#{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{memberId}, #{couponId}, now())
mapper.select: select id, status, publish_count as publishCount, receive_count as receiveCount, start_time as startTime, end_time as endTime from sms_coupon where id = #{id} for update
mapper.update: update coupon_source_grant set history_id = #{historyId}, delivered_at = now() where source_type = #{sourceType} and source_id = #{sourceId} and history_id is null
